member.name: P:Intersect.Configuration.ClientConfiguration.HideHairHelmets
member.summary: Paperdoll base-names of full helmets that fully encase the head (e.g. an egg shell or closed helm). When one of these is equipped the player's hair and back-hair are not drawn, so the head appears to sit *inside* the helmet - matching how full helmets hide hair in other 2D MMOs (Ragnarok, Tibia, etc.). List the paperdoll name with or without the .png extension, e.g. "helmet_egghat". Open headgear (hats, circlets, the top hat) should NOT be listed - they keep hair.

member.name: P:Intersect.Configuration.ClientConfiguration.FallbackHairHelmets
member.summary: Paperdoll base-names of head-covering helmets (e.g. the egg shell) that show the player's hair as a fringe underneath, BUT swap to a compact gendered "fallback" hair (helmethair_m / helmethair_f, tinted to the player's hair colour) when the player's chosen hair is too big to fit cleanly under the helmet (it would poke out). Hairs that fit keep their own style. This keeps gender readable while avoiding pokes, for any current or future hair.

member.name: P:Intersect.Configuration.ClientConfiguration.FallbackHairPokeTolerance
member.summary: How many hair pixels may stick out beyond a FallbackHairHelmets helmet's silhouette (within its covered band) before the hair is judged "too big" and swapped for the fallback. Higher = more tolerant (real hair kept more often).

member.name: P:Intersect.Configuration.ClientConfiguration.ForceFallbackHairStyles
member.summary: Hair base-names (e.g. "hair_3") that should ALWAYS use the gendered fallback hair when a FallbackHairHelmets helmet is worn, regardless of the auto fit check — for hairstyles that technically "fit" but still look off under the helmet.
